name: credits
title: Credits
description: An actor's site set like the billing block at the foot of a film poster: the name and every part played run into one centred block of tall condensed capitals on an aubergine panel, with a dated list of credits beneath that prints on A4.

tokens.--font-body: the plain grotesque on the visitor's device: running text, summaries, contact lines
tokens.--font-billing: the tall condensed capitals: the name, the parts, headings, dates, menu and labels
tokens.--text-label: the tiny stacked production labels on the billing, and the Skills label on the card
tokens.--text-s: small text: the headline over the name, the role line, menu, contacts, places, footer
tokens.--text-l: opening sentences, CV dates, skills on the card
tokens.--text-billing: the parts on the billing block
tokens.--text-name: the name on the billing panel, the largest type
tokens.--leading-tight: line spacing of the billing block and page titles
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of small capitals: menu, labels, productions on the CV
tokens.--tracking-billing: letter spacing of the parts on the billing
tokens.--color-bg: the white stock behind every page (deep aubergine after dark)
tokens.--color-text: body text, page titles and the parts on the CV
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: productions on the CV, places, the print note, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: aubergine ink: dates, heavy rules, list marks, links, the Print button, focus rings on white
tokens.--color-rule: thin rules between CV entries, table rows and above the footer
tokens.--color-panel: the billing panel, the masthead strip and the profile card
tokens.--color-name: the name on the panel, the site title, the current menu item
tokens.--color-billing: lilac: the parts on the billing, skills on the card, current-page underline, CV button edge, focus rings on the panel
tokens.--color-label: the stacked labels, the headline and the links on the panel
tokens.--color-panel-muted: the role line and the menu on the panel
tokens.--color-panel-rule: the rules above and below the billing block, and the underline of the links on the panel
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--label-width: how wide a stacked label runs before it wraps
tokens.--when-width: width of the date column on the CV
tokens.--space-5: largest gap: inside panels, above page titles, below content
tokens.--radius: corners of the CV button, the Print button and code: almost square
